subject: Org entry + API provisioning for Acme Analytics - coordination
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-10T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Handoff: initial org entry + API key plan for Acme

Hi Logan / Alex —

Quick handoff: Acme is ready to start tenant onboarding next week (kickoff Wed 1/13). They asked for a concrete plan for creating their first project, issuing API keys, and the recommended role layout so their devs can get started with an integration spike.

Key details I captured in discovery:
- Org name: Acme Analytics (will use: acme-analytics-prod)
- First project: "acme-ingest" for streaming ingestion + evals later
- Compliance note: they want keys rotated monthly and audit log export to their GCP project
- They requested service-account patterns and a sample role CSV

I've attached a draft mutual action plan (acme_onboarding_mpa.xlsx) and a starter role matrix. Please see the proposed timeline on tab 2.

Ask for you (Logan / Dev): please confirm the minimal set of roles we should create in the tenant, the API key provisioning flow (service account vs user key), and whether we should pre-create the project or let them create it during kickoff.

Alex — copying you so you have line of sight. If Procurement needs the SOW/DocuSign link I included it in related links below.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: acme_onboarding_mpa.xlsx (spreadsheet), initial-role-matrix.csv (CSV)
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-10T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: initial org entry + API key plan for Acme

Thanks Marissa — jumping in. High level answers below, will follow with a short checklist and a pre-created project proposal.

Short answers:
- Roles: create three RBAC roles for initial phase: Admin (full tenant management + billing), Engineer (model endpoints, keys, deployments), and Viewer (read-only dashboards). Avoid granting Admin to more than two people.
- Keys: recommend service-account-based API keys for applications (rotated programmatically) + ephemeral user keys for individual dev debugging. We'll provide a service-account template (attached).
- Project creation: I recommend we pre-create the project "acme-ingest" in their tenant to reduce kickoff friction, then transfer ownership to Acme's org admin within 2 weeks.

I'll assemble a 6-step tenant setup checklist and a short script for service account creation and key rotation. Dev — can you confirm the exact scope strings for the Engineer role (compute:invoke, models:deploy, logs:read)?

Logan
Logan Wright
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.ai

Attachments: service-account-template.json
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: 2027-01-10T13:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: initial org entry + API key plan for Acme

Thanks both — this looks good. A couple quick clarifications from our side before kickoff:
- Procurement asked whether the created project and keys will live in Redwood's control plane or in our GCP billing account. We prefer keys and billing under our account for audit reasons.
- For SSO, we will use Okta; we want to invite 4 initial users: two engineers, one security contact, and one admin.

If you can pre-create the tenant skeleton (roles + project folder) but keep the actual API key issuance during the kickoff under our account, that'd be ideal. Also please include a short guide for Okta provisioning.

Alex
Alex Chen
Platform Lead, Acme Analytics
alex.chen@acmeanalytics.com
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: 2027-01-11T09:23:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: initial org entry + API key plan for Acme

On Sun, Jan 10, 2027 at 11:02 AM Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai> wrote:
> I'll assemble a 6-step tenant setup checklist and a short script for service account creation and key rotation. Dev — can you confirm the exact scope strings for the Engineer role (compute:invoke, models:deploy, logs:read)?

Confirmed. Proposed Engineer scope (concise scope tokens we use in ACLs):
- inference:endpoint.invoke
- model:versions.deploy
- logs:read
- billing:usage.view (optional)

Notes on API keys / provisioning flow:
1) We'll pre-create the tenant and project skeleton in the Redwood control plane (no keys issued). Folder name: acme-analytics/acme-ingest
2) During kickoff we'll generate a service account in the tenant and produce a key package; Acme will request key export into their GCP project (we support importing the key into their KMS) — this satisfies their audit preference.
3) We'll set up an automated rotation job (30 days) and expose rotation webhooks that Acme can wire into their secrets manager.
4) Okta: we will provide an IdP SAML guide and an SCIM connector doc to automate user provisioning.

I'll attach a short CSV with the suggested role assignments (initial-role-matrix.csv) and the service-account-template.json we mentioned earlier.

- Dev
Dev Patel
Senior Systems Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.ai

Attachments: initial-role-matrix.csv, service-account-template.json
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: 2027-01-12T11:48:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: initial org entry + API key plan for Acme

Appreciate the clarity. Final confirmation from our side:
- Pre-create the tenant skeleton and project folder (no keys).
- We'll handle the actual key export into our GCP KMS during the kickoff session on 1/13 at 10:00am PT.
- Please share the Okta SCIM connector doc and the rotation webhook URL before kickoff.

Procurement will follow up separately on the DocuSign SOW link.

See you Wed — Alex
